what_it_does: Going forward, account level security features will be available to all accounts immediately upon General Availability (GA), without requiring account admins to manually enable them on the Previews page. Account admins must still configure these features before they take effect. This includes features for network connectivity (such as private connectivity), network security (such as ingress and egress controls), encryption, and enhanced security and compliance.
